notes.title: Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h2]🐞🎲 [b]Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW![/b] 🎲🐞[/h2][p]The wait is over — [b]Dicey Bugs[/b] has officially launched! It’s time to roll, capture, and conquer your way by controlling the battle in this bug-collecting adventure.[/p][p][b]What’s waiting for you inside?[/b][/p][list][*][p]🪲 [b]Capture & collect[/b] hundreds of adorable bugs[/p][/*][*][p]🎲 [b]Customize every die[/b] to craft your perfect strategy[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Experiment with hundreds of builds[/b] — no two runs are the same[/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Boost your power[/b] with equipment & consumables[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Complete challenges[/b] to earn stamps and flex your progress[/p][/*][*][p]📺 [b]Twitch integration[/b] for wild, chat-driven chaos[/p][/*][*][p]📊 [b]Track your best runs[/b] and show off your stats[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]Steam Deck ready[/b] — play anywhere[/p][/*][*][p]♾️ [b]Endless replayability[/b] where you control the run from the very first roll[/p][/*][/list][p]🔥 Whether you’re here for the strategy, the chaos, or the cute-but-deadly critters, [b]Dicey Bugs[/b] is ready to take over your game nights.[/p][p]👉 [b]Play now on Steam[/b]: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438640/Dicey_Bugs"]Dicey Bugs[/url][/p]

notes.title: Rolling Out Soon!
notes.content: [h1]Releasing on September 12th @ 8am MST[/h1][p][b]DEMO & FULL GAME[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adds preview icons above units while hovering over specific actions.[/p][olist][*][p][b]Dice:[/b] Shows which unit(s) will be healed, strengthened, have a status effect applied, etc.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bottle:[/b] Shows which units can currently be caught or the target HP to make the them catchable.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p]Adds [b]KO Rewards[/b] (bonus coins earned for defeating enemies in skillful ways like overkill, instakill, doublekill, etc)[/p][/*][*][p]Adds equipment that allows attacking a rear unit.[/p][/*][*][p]Coins and bottles will now be collected through equipment even when the battle is over.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates attack previews to only show if the unit will actually where units weren't always receiving buffs in the correct order.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where shop items were not always being deselected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where the Free Movement preview was remaining on.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where scrolling while using controller was not always working.[/p][/*][*][p]Small fixes and updates for specific units (visuals, stats, abilities, habitats, notes.title: Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
[h3]STEAMDECK SUPPORT[/h3][p]Now you can capture all your favorite bugs and build your favorite team on the go![/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes & Updates[/h3][p][b]DEMO:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adds a "Randomize Party" button to the Party Selection that chooses 3 random units from your collection.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds Spanish and Japanese languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates the names and/or icons for Ranged Attack, Support Attack, and Ambush actions for easier clarity and readability.[/p][/*][*][p]Allows unit positions to be swapped while in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where KO, Ally KO, and Revive abilities were not always triggering correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where Lure was not always being removed if the unit is KO'd.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where confusion previews were using STR rather than damage dealt.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes some achievements that were not triggering correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updates supporters list.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]FULL GAME:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adds a new unit and variant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes "Fastest Run Time" stat not showing the correct time.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Try the big demo update for Dicey Bugs, a turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides
notes.content:
Dicey Bugs is a roguelike, turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides of the battles. A new demo is live now!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/try-the-big-demo-update-for-dicey-bugs-a-turn-based-deckbuilder-where-you-control-both-sides/

notes.title: Demo 2.0.0
notes.content: [h1]Demo[/h1][h3]Features[/h3][list][*][p]Adds the ability to save and continue a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds an exit shop button.[/p][/*][*][p]Field guide added.[/p][/*][*][p]New dice & consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]New battle backgrounds and music.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to reset progression data.[/p][/*][*][p]Preview potential units before entering a battle.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Updates difficulty scaling.[/p][/*][*][p]Removes "Miss" feedback when using Idle dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Map graphics Overhaul.[/p][/*][*][p]Game menu Overhaul.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes dead units from being allowed to become strengthened.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Full Game Progress[/h1][list][*][p]Adds Starter Dice (grants the ability to swap out 3 different die faces at the start of a run after they've been unlocked by completing runs). [b]Not available in demo.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Adds Expert Mode (toggles run difficulty by modifying the bottle amount, shop prices, enemy dice, and enemy strength). [b]Not available in demo.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Adds Battle Hazards (special battle events that trigger an effect on both parties each turn). [b]Not available in demo.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Adds Steam Achievements. [b]Not available in demo.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Enemies can spawn with equipment. [b]Not available in demo.[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.5
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixes "Move" ability getting triggered when a unit is revived but the party did not move[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes the Start sfx playing twice when using controller on a brand new game[/p][/*][*][p]Adds leader icon to the map party[/p][/*][*][p]Updates some animations[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.2
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixes UI getting cut off in 16:10 resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Rearranges UI (settings button is now on the right)[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a preview icon to preview which unit will become the leader during movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds leader icons to the units in front.[/p][/*][*][p]Party members are no longer lost when ending a run from the Map scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot music has been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Mixed rewards now always show up in the same order (dice, equipment, consumable)[/p][/*][*][p]Various small graphic & animation polishes and fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.content: [list][*][p]Adds new "Scare" action for die faces and consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds tutorials for Player Party and Run Completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds tutorial titles to the tutorial boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a notification animation to the shop once you are able to purchase an item.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds navigation to show which map you're currently on.[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a tooltip to the speed settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite & Boss units now drop more coins.[/p][/*][*][p]Consumables are now limited to 5, rather than 10.[/p][/*][*][p]The consumables bar is now fully shown, regardless of how many you have.[/p][/*][*][p]The first ever dice roll is now predetermined to help teach players.[/p][/*][*][p]Coin rewards have been removed from the tutorial battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Player dice no longer get grayed out when they are ineffective.[/p][/*][*][p]The difficulty curve has been slightly modified.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug where the KO animation was not always playing correctly on fast mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes controller support breaking during loot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes consumables not triggering a "Miss" when the action is unusable[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.10
notes.content: [h1]Change Log[/h1][olist][*][p]Updates enemy stats scaling for a better challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Updates map generation more interesting routes[/p][/*][*][p]Updates boss fights for an additional challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Unit stats have been re-balanced[/p][/*][*][p]Removes double and single unit battles in favor the more interesting three unit battles[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h1]Additions[/h1][olist][*][p]Adds Elite Battles which offer a strong single unit battle with an additional challenge to overcome before they can be defeated[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a Tutorial Battle for first time players [/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist]
